extDescription.message: Choose the time zone and language that claude.ai reads in this browser.

previewOff.message: Off: claude.ai reads this browser’s own settings

previewHeaderNative.message: Sent by this browser as usual

zoneSearchPlaceholder.message: Search a city or an offset like +05:30

importOpensTab.message: Choose the profile file in this tab.

savedOn.message: Saved. Open claude.ai tabs pick this up when they next load.

savedOff.message: Saved. Turn the override on to use it on claude.ai.

turnedOn.message: On. Open claude.ai tabs pick this up when they next load.

turnedOff.message: Off. Open claude.ai tabs return to this browser’s settings when they next load.

applyFailed.message: The change was saved but not applied: $ERROR$

scriptStepFailed.message: Saved, but the claude.ai script was not updated: $ERROR$

headerStepFailed.message: Saved, but the Accept-Language rule was not updated: $ERROR$

checkNotClaude.message: Open claude.ai in this tab first.

checkDone.message: Checked what scripts in this tab read.

checkAlias.message: Chrome reports $OBSERVED$ for $SELECTED$; both names resolve to the same zone, so this counts as a match.

checkOff.message: The override is off, so differences from Selected are expected.

checkScope.message: This checks only what page JavaScript reads in this tab. It does not check the Accept-Language header or any network traffic.

errReadFile.message: The file could not be read.

errNotJSON.message: The file is not valid JSON.

errNotObject.message: A profile must be a JSON object.

errUnknownKey.message: Unsupported key “$KEY$”. Profiles only hold schema, version, timeZone, locale and cli.

errUnknownTimeZone.message: “$ZONE$” is not a supported IANA time zone.

scopeNote.message: Changes the time zone and language that scripts on claude.ai read and the Accept-Language header it receives. Not Web Workers, your IP address or your account. Tabs pick this up on their next load.
